title: Add model-family classification + seq-length bucket features to kernel selector (v2)
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Goal
Implement two core feature signals required by kernel auto-selection v2:
1) Model-family classification (architecture tagging) used by selector rules
2) Sequence-length bucketing + prefill/decode regime extraction used by selector rules and stability guardrails

Context
Selector v2 decision rules require stable, deterministic inputs so we can (a) explain why a kernel was chosen, (b) replay decisions, and (c) avoid long-context misclassification that produces p95/p99 spikes.

Scope
A) Model-family classification
- Add a lightweight classifier that maps model metadata (config / architecture tags) into a canonical model_family enum.
- First-pass families: llama, mistral, qwen, gemma, unknown.
- Must handle common variants/suffixes (e.g., instruct, chat, -it, -hf) without changing family.
- Must be deterministic and pure (no network calls; no reliance on request content).

B) Seq-length bucketing + regime signals
- Extract seq_length features for selection:
  - prompt_tokens (prefill length)
  - max_new_tokens (decode length target)
  - total_tokens_target = prompt_tokens + max_new_tokens
- Map to canonical buckets used across runtime + benchmarks (exact names required for telemetry + dashboards):
  - prompt_bucket: s(0-256), m(257-1k), l(1k-4k), xl(4k-16k), xxl(16k+)
  - decode_bucket: s(0-128), m(129-512), l(513-2k), xl(2k+)
- Add a derived regime label (prefill_heavy | balanced | decode_heavy) using a simple ratio heuristic documented in code comments.

Non-goals
- Do not implement the full v2 decision rules here (that lives in the selector core ticket/PR).
- Do not add GPU SKU mapping here.

Acceptance criteria
- The selector feature struct includes:
  - model_family (string/enum)
  - prompt_bucket, decode_bucket (canonical bucket labels)
  - regime (prefill_heavy/balanced/decode_heavy)
  - raw prompt_tokens/max_new_tokens preserved for debug/replay
- Determinism: given the same request + model metadata, feature extraction produces identical output across processes and hosts.
- Safety: unknown model types default to model_family=unknown and conservative buckets; feature extraction must never throw.
- Performance: feature extraction adds <1 microsecond overhead in microbench (excluding logging/telemetry).

Unit test plan
1) Model-family tests
- Table-driven tests for known model metadata inputs -> expected model_family.
- Variant handling: ensure suffixes/prefixes do not change family.
- Unknown handling: missing/partial config returns unknown (no crash).

2) Seq bucket tests
- Boundary tests for every bucket edge (e.g., 256/257, 1024/1025, 4096/4097, 16384/16385; decode edges 128/129, 512/513, 2048/2049).
- Regime heuristic tests with representative (prompt_tokens, max_new_tokens) pairs:
  - (2048, 64) => prefill_heavy
  - (256, 1024) => decode_heavy
  - (512, 512) => balanced
- Property-style sanity test: buckets must be non-empty labels; negative values clamp to 0.

3) Determinism / pure function tests
- Same input -> same output across repeated runs.
- Feature extraction does not inspect request text or prompt contents; only token counts + model metadata.

Links / implementation notes
- Design doc: sources/confluence/eng-serving-runtime/kernel-and-scheduling/kernel-auto-selection-v2-design.json
- Related PRs:
  - sources/github/redwood/pr-28428-add-model-family-classifier-for-kernel-selection.json
  - sources/github/redwood/pr-28439-seq-length-bucketing-and-prefill-decode-signal.json

Rollout notes
- Feature fields must match telemetry naming conventions (see standards doc) because dashboards + allow/deny rules will key off these bucket labels.
- Any future bucket renames must be gated and coordinated with observability pack.

Owner
- Primary: Yuki Sato
- Reviewers: Lena Fischer (regime heuristics), Noah Patel (determinism/correctness)
comments: 2026-01-16 (Yuki Sato): Starting with canonical enums + bucket label strings. Will keep raw counts for replay/debug. Need Lena to sanity check the regime heuristic thresholds before landing.

2026-01-18 (Lena Fischer): Heuristic suggestion: treat prefill_heavy when prompt_tokens >= 4x max_new_tokens; decode_heavy when max_new_tokens >= 2x prompt_tokens; else balanced. Avoid using total_tokens_target alone—long-context prefill is what bites tail latency.

2026-01-21 (Noah Patel): Please ensure feature extraction is a pure function. No reliance on global config, no time-based jitter, no randomization. Add boundary unit tests for buckets; clamp negatives to 0 to avoid panics from bad inputs.
2026-01-27 (Yuki Sato): PRs up for review: model-family classifier + seq bucketing. Added table-driven tests and boundary edges. Microbench shows ~0.3µs overhead per request for feature extraction.

2026-02-03 (Yuki Sato): Merged. Bucket labels aligned with perf suite + dashboard spec. Follow-up: ensure telemetry sampling doesn’t explode cardinality once raw counts are included (ENG-4824 tracking).
